title: 「Regardless of + noun ／ wh-clause」表示「不論／不管……」
titleZh: 「Regardless of + noun ／ wh-clause」表示「不論／不管……」

source.file: Sentence Structure 258 -「Regardless of + noun _ wh-clause」表示「不論／不管……」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF does not provide a complete English counterpart, the English text is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than the system lesson because two distinct source PDFs are labelled 201; source number N therefore maps to system ID ssN+1.

formula: Regardless of + noun or wh-clause, + main clause.

formulas.formula: Regardless of + noun or noun phrase, + main clause.
Main clause + regardless of + noun or noun phrase.
Regardless of whether + subject + verb, + main clause.
Regardless of how + adjective / adverb + clause, + main clause.

example: Regardless of whether we agree, we must follow the procedure.
exampleZh: 不論我們是否同意，我們都必須遵守程序。

examples.en: Regardless of whether we agree, we must follow the procedure.

meaning.zh: Regardless of 是完整的介詞片語，表示即使所提因素不同，主要行動、規則、決定或結果仍然不變。of 後面可接名詞片語或完整而自然的 wh-子句。

rules.zh: 核心表達是 regardless of；of 是固定部分，不能省略，也不可改用 to 或 for。
rules.en: The core expression is regardless of. Of is a fixed part and must not be omitted or replaced by to or for.

rules.zh: Regardless of 後面可以接簡單或較長的名詞片語，包括冠詞、形容詞、所有格和多個名詞。
rules.en: Regardless of can be followed by a simple or longer noun phrase containing articles, adjectives, possessives or more than one noun.

rules.zh: 表達兩種可能時使用 whether：regardless of whether + subject + verb。or not 可加入，但不是固定句型的一部分；本課不用較口語化的 if。
rules.en: Use whether when there are two possibilities: regardless of whether + subject + verb. Or not is optional and is not part of the fixed structure; this exercise does not use the more conversational if.

rules.zh: Regardless of 後面也可接 what、who、where、when、how 或 which 等 wh-子句；子句必須表達完整而自然的意思。
rules.en: Other wh-clauses with what, who, where, when, how or which can follow regardless of. The wh-clause must express a complete and natural meaning.

rules.zh: 此表達可放在句首、句末或句中。句首片語後通常加逗號；句末通常不用逗號；句中作補充資料時前後通常加逗號。
rules.en: The expression may appear at the beginning, end or middle of a sentence. A fronted phrase is normally followed by a comma; a final phrase usually needs no comma; a parenthetical phrase normally takes commas on both sides.

rules.zh: 它可以配合情態動詞、被動語態、疑問句、報告動詞、命令句和條件句使用，位置不必每次相同。
rules.en: It can be used with modal verbs, passive sentences, questions, reporting verbs, commands and conditional sentences, and need not always appear in the same position.

rules.zh: 所提因素即使改變，也不能改變主要結果；這正是 regardless of 所表達的邏輯。
rules.en: The named factor must not change the main result: the action, rule, decision or outcome remains the same even if that factor varies.

rules.zh: Despite 通常指出已知的困難或相反事實；regardless of 表示某因素無論如何變化都不影響結果，因此範圍通常較廣。
rules.en: Despite normally identifies a known difficulty or contrary fact, whereas regardless of says that variations in a factor do not affect the result and therefore usually has a broader scope.

benefits.zh: 它讓讀者立即知道，即使某項因素改變，主要決定或行動仍然相同。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that one factor does not change the result.

benefits.zh: 它可以把較長的解釋合併成一句，使意思更簡潔直接。
benefits.en: It can replace a longer explanation and combine the idea into one concise sentence.

benefits.zh: 它常用於說明規則適用於所有人或不應因背景、年齡、性別、國籍或財政狀況而有不同待遇，有助表達公平和一視同仁。
benefits.en: It helps express fairness and equal treatment by showing that rules or decisions do not vary with background, age, sex, nationality or financial circumstances.

benefits.zh: 它先指出不會影響結果的因素，再說明真正重要的行動或結果，能清楚連接條件和主要訊息。
benefits.en: It connects a condition and the main message clearly by naming a factor that does not affect the action or result.

benefits.zh: 片語可放在句首、句末或句中，提供多種組織句子的方法，避免所有句子以相同方式開始。
benefits.en: It gives you several ways to organise a sentence because the phrase may appear at the beginning, end or middle.

benefits.zh: 它可用於表達決心、制定規則、解釋政策、作出承諾、提供服務、安全指示、報告和議論文，適合口語和正式寫作。
benefits.en: It is useful in speaking and formal writing for expressing determination, rules, policies, promises, services, safety instructions, reports and essays.

en: Rewrite each sentence using regardless of + noun or wh-clause.
Preserve the original meaning, tense, voice and important details. The target may appear at the beginning, middle or end. The first word is provided.
zh: 使用 regardless of + 名詞或 wh-子句 改寫以下句子。
保留原句的意思、時態、語態及重要資料。目標句型可放在句首、句中或句末。每題已提供答案的第一個字。
